column1: # keccak.tsv: hash vectors from the sha3 0.10.9 / sha2 0.10.9 crates (the ones nova uses).
# keccak256 <msg hex> <digest hex>   original Keccak (0x01 padding), used by Keccak256Transcript
# sha3_256 <msg> <digest>            NIST SHA3-256 (0x06 padding), used by nova's DigestComputer (pp_digest, vk digest)
# sha256 <msg> <digest>              SHA-256, used by hash-to-curve expand_message_xmd
# The empty-message lines are standard known answers (asserted).
